title: Persistent homology-based explicit topological control for 2D topology optimization with MMA
summary: Controlling structural complexity, particularly the number of holes, remains a fundamental challenge in topology optimization, with significant implications for both theoretical analysis and manufacturability. Most existing approaches rely on indirect strategies, such as filtering techniques, minimum length-scale control, or specific level-set initializations, which influence topology only implicitly and do not allow precise regulation of topological features.
